description: Phase 1 performance budgets for the Architech public prototype. Re-baselined 18 Sep 2026 after the TechnoProperty mobile workspace added authenticated drawer and bottom navigation, persisted card/table inventory views, and accessible optimistic action workflows across the broker routes: total static JS measured 2248.6 KiB and the aggregate cap moved to 2.24 MiB with 2.1% headroom. Individual route and gzip caps remain unchanged because every route still passes them. Prior re-baselines: 26 Aug 2026 locality intelligence (2.16 MiB total) and 25 Aug 2026 parity overlay (2.15 MiB total). Re-measured 19 Sep 2026 (PERF-R5-006): total static JS 2158.9 KiB after the animation runtime was removed from 16 routes' first load — cap unchanged at 2.24 MiB, headroom now 5.9%.

/search.why: /search ships the map and filter stack, so it is the heaviest route and already exceeded the 770000 default before this branch (758.8 KiB at c35247f). Update: the arena branch grew it ~14.3 KiB raw (759.6 KiB at c17c155 → 773.9 KiB at 4f7a308) via palette filter actions, Hindi search copy, and bbox/facet wiring — shipped features measured in the bundle, not drift. Ceiling raised to 820000 raw to admit that work with a hard guard margin; gzip stays 245000 (multiplied content compresses better than the raw line suggests). Re-ratchet 6 Sep 2026 (performance-audit finding F2): measured build on 2a447df merged with origin/main b08c481 ships /search at 737.9 KiB raw / 228.4 KiB gzip — ~36 KiB below the 4f7a308 reading after MapLibre vendoring and router churn settled. Ceiling lowered 820000 → 780000 to restore regression sensitivity (~5.7% raw guard margin); gzip budget unchanged at 245000. The ratchet rule is unchanged: this line moves only with a measured before/after in the why. Re-ratchet 19 Sep 2026 (PERF-R5-006): the enforced pair had drifted to 900000/280000 while this line still recorded 780000/245000 — so the gate could not catch the regression this entry exists to catch, and /search had reached 874.8 KiB raw / 272.8 KiB gzip. Root cause found and fixed: components/architech/Reveal.tsx imported motion/react (the library's only import in src), putting 116.8 KiB of animation runtime on the first load of 16 routes, /search among them — on the very route this entry says the library blew. Restoring the stylesheet reveal primitive that theme.css and design-token-discipline.test.ts already describe measured 758.2 KiB raw / 234.8 KiB gzip on the same commit, so the enforced values are restored to the documented ones rather than re-invented. Measured margin now 0.46% raw / 1.86% gzip: deliberately tight, because the sensitivity is the point. Any future addition to /search's client code should re-ratchet with a fresh measured before/after in this field, not by editing the numbers alone.
